item.title: MAS-Lab Accepted at AGNTCon + MCPCon Europe
item.description: “MAS-Lab: An Open Framework for Spec-Driven, Interoperable Multi-Agent Systems” has been accepted at AGNTCon + MCPCon Europe 2026. I’ll be presenting this work and also attending as chair of the AAIF Accuracy and Reliability working group.

item.title: AAIF Chairs Interview on Open Source and Agentic AI
item.description: Interview with colleagues at the AAIF on open source and agentic AI. We discuss why open source matters for agentic systems, and the standards we’re building around agent failure modes, multi-agent observability, and operational practices for production AI systems.

item.title: MAS-Lab Open-Source Release and arXiv Paper
item.description: We have released MAS-Lab, a specification-driven validation framework for reliable multi-agent systems, as open source on GitHub, together with an arXiv preprint.

item.title: New Aether Paper on Agentic AI Network Validation
item.description: Our paper on Aether, a framework combining multi-agent AI with network digital twins for autonomous network validation, is now available on arXiv.

item.title: Elected Chair of the AAIF Accuracy and Reliability WG
item.description: Elected chair of the Accuracy and Reliability working group in the AAIF Agentic AI Foundation, alongside Casper Nielsen from Diagrid as co-chair.

item.title: Swisscom White Paper: Production Results Released
item.description: Technical whitepaper documenting our agentic AI platform’s production deployment results at Swisscom with detailed use cases.

item.title: AIEWF 2025: Multi-Agent AI and Network Knowledge Graphs
item.description: Presentation on multi-agent systems for network change validation using knowledge graphs and AI orchestration.

item.title: Cisco Live US 2025: Agentic AI and NetDevOps Session
item.description: Presentation on agentic network change validation at Cisco Live US, covering AI-driven verification and NetDevOps automation.

item.title: Outshift and Swisscom: Building Agentic AI Networks
item.description: Announcing our collaboration with Swisscom on AI-driven network reliability using network digital twins and AI agents.
